# Stay01 demonstration media

`paraxe/stay-01/coastal-house.png` is an original generated concept image created with imagegen for this Paraxe demonstration on 9 November 2026. It depicts a fictional coastal guesthouse, not a real property or a booking offer.

The scene was requested as editorial architectural photography of a modest limestone/timber guesthouse among dune grasses and coastal pines in soft afternoon light. No third-party reference photograph was used.

The generated source has been copied into the project. Replace the photograph, alt text, image credit, room information, rates, and fictional notice when adapting the block. Concept room plans are local vector illustrations and are not measured floor plans or accessibility documentation.
